## Introduction

Playwright is available in multiple languages.

## JavaScript and TypeScript

Playwright for Node.js comes with its own test runner.
* [Documentation](https://playwright.dev/docs/intro)

## Python

Playwright Pytest plugin is the recommended way.
* [Documentation](https://playwright.dev/python/docs/intro)

## Java

JUnit or TestNG based on your project requirements.

## .NET

MSTest, NUnit, xUnit base classes.
